title: Returns and Damaged Goods Policy
text: Report a damaged chair within 7 calendar days of delivery. Provide the order number and clear photographs. A support officer records the request; a refund is not automatic.

title: Damaged Chair Triage Procedure
text: Open a support Case, attach the order number and photographs, check the delivery date, and assign the Case to the Returns team. Do not promise a replacement before review.

title: Returns Manager Approval Guide
text: In this fictional exercise, only a Returns manager may approve an exception above AUD750. This document does not authorise the assistant to approve an exception.

title: Support Case EOS-1042
text: Case EOS-1042 concerns a damaged chair for Example Customer. Its status is New, priority is Medium, and owner is the Returns team. No refund has been approved.
